name: Valdecaballeros (Spain)
description: Square white flag with a red cross throughout, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Valdecaballeros (a cross of Alcántara and a tower).
history: Municipal flag of Valdecaballeros; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Valdecaballeros arms — cross of Alcántara and tower
